chunks.text:
[Intro]
{a wind gust swells and cuts, and the lead fires a quick hopping kite riff over a snare pickup, straight into the theme}
positive_styles: 16-bit console RPG soundtrack from the mid-1990s
retro sampled-chip instruments with the warm echo of a 16-bit sound chip
bright staccato pulse-wave lead that springs up on the downbeat and skips back down
fast flickering broken-triad arpeggio shimmering above like a kite tail
plucked sampled bass walking in steady eighths
skipping sampled snare and tambourine with timpani accents on the gusts
white-noise wind gust swells that rise and cut every four bars
high-altitude cliff-town overworld theme, wind and kites at sunset

chunks.text:
